text_block_list.text:
The day of the Fan Fest has arrived, and
Hishi
Amazon is participating in the
events.

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Gather round for the spiciest fight ever!
The
leaders of Miho and Ritto Dorm will
be competing
in a high-stakes curry
cook-off!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, please turn your attention to
the
display monitor!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh, are we on? All right then... Ahem!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
The name's Hishi Amazon, and I'm the
leader of
Miho Dormitory!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm stakin' the reputation of my dorm on
this
battle, and I won't be beaten!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, well that makes two of us. I have
no
intention of losing either.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whoever wins will receive free carrot ice
cream
for their entire dorm, and my dear
ponies are all
looking forward to
enjoying a cool treat.

text_block_list.name: Ritto Student
text_block_list.text:
Squee! You look so good on the big
screen, Fuji!

text_block_list.name: Miho Student
text_block_list.text:
Yeeeah! Show 'em what you're made of,
Hishiama!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Our judge for today is none other than
Oguri
Cap!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm happy to be here!

With the crowd hungry for action, the
cook-off
begins!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Grrraaah! I'm gonna dice ya to
smithereens!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Hishiama is chopping through carrots
left and
right!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Need to make sure there's plenty
of 'em for
Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm always cooking up a storm for my
residents, so
this should be a piece of
cake!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure our judge will appreciate the
effort!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
As for what Fuji is up to... Oh! She's
blended
together a symphony of spices!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you're rather graceful with the
kitchen
knife, Hishiama. I'm positive your
curry will turn
out great.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I won't stand a chance against you with
just any
old strategy.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So this time around... I'm going to spice
things
up—literally.

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
On one side, we have a homely
Japanese-style
curry and on the other,
we have a spicy Indian
curry! This is
turning out to be quite the cook-off!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Both dishes are finished and ready to be

presented onstage! They smell
absolutely
delightful!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
My curry is sure to satisfy even the
hungriest
growing gal. It's chock-full of
healthy veggies and
meaty chunks of
fried chicken!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Here I have an Indian curry, made with a
blend of
spices. I've also prepared a
lassi, salad, and
cheese naan to
accompany it.

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Wow! These are two drastically different
dishes,
but they're both equally
stunning!

text_block_list.name: Hishiama and Fuji
text_block_list.text: Please enjoy!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I sure will!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap is savoring the curries, bite by
bite!
Which one will please her palate
the most?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: It's... a tie!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
What's this?! What an unexpected
answer! What
do you mean by this,
Oguri Cap?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Both curries are warm, nourishing, and
delicious.
Therefore, neither is better
than the other!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Who could have seen this coming?! Even
the
audience is astir with confusion!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What the judge says goes! If she says it's
a draw,
then it's a draw!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm happy enough that I got to partake
in such a
fiery competition, so no
complaints here!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I have to agree with Hishiama. We
shouldn't force
a decision.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
How about we split the carrot ice cream
between
our dorms?

With both of the dorm leaders happy to
move on,
the audience follows suit.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thank you for the wonderful meal.

And so, the curry competition concludes

smoothly with smiles all around.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
What's happened to Oguri Cap?! She
hasn't
moved an inch since tasting
Hishiama's curry!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
This flavor... it's just like the stuff they
serve at
Masae, a mom-and-pop
restaurant back in my
hometown!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
These big chunks of carrots, hunks of
extra crispy
meat, and soy
sauce-flavored fried chicken...

Everything is identical!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Masae! I hope you're doing well!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: My goodness, Oguri Cap is in tears!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what's happenin'... but if
she's happy,
that goes for me too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Come on, have some more! There's
plenty for
seconds and thirds!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Masaeee!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Pfft, haha! Goodness, this is clearly my
loss. You
are a force to be reckoned
with, Hishiama.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Your gentle, tender heart was what
brought back
such precious memories to
Oguri.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
This wasn't how I imagined myself
winning.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: But, well, I guess it doesn't feel too bad!

And with that, the Fan Fest wraps up as
a huge
success!

The Masae-style curry goes on to
become a
limited-time cafeteria dish,
but that's another
story.
